themes.name: Trading & Order Execution Issues
themes.description: Unreliable trade execution and transaction flows: orders often fail, hang, or time out, and missing order types or delayed settlements cause frustration and losses. Users report buy/sell orders not completing, errors on exit, and IPO/allotment check problems. These failures directly impact investors' ability to trade effectively.
example_quotes: sell order is not executing... still shows error.
When placing order in intraday it place order really late and sometimes even after 20 mins order pending

themes.name: App Performance & Stability
themes.description: Frequent app glitches and crashes undermine reliability. Slow loading and data errors frustrate users; for example, charts or quotes lag or reset unexpectedly. Some users note the app otherwise runs smoothly, but many encounter intermittent bugs that erode confidence.
example_quotes: Too much glitch, option chain not open properly... sometimes working, sometimes not working.
App crashes every time I try to view my portfolio

themes.name: Fees & Charges Transparency
themes.description: Unexpected brokerage and hidden fees frustrate users by eating into profits. Many complain that nominal-sounding charges add up: e.g. a small trade yields far less profit after 'high brokerage' and undisclosed fees. Users demand clearer pricing, lower commissions, and disclosure of all deductions.
example_quotes: worst app ever... very high brokerage.. and hidden charges.. in 7k profit I got only 940 rs.
brokerage is a nightmare for scalpers. sometimes even if I am in profit, at the end of the day i end up paying money

themes.name: User Interface & Usability
themes.description: Generally praised for a clean, intuitive design and easy onboarding, but some users report cluttered screens, unnecessary taps, and confusing navigation. For example, the default landing page may require extra scrolling to reach a watchlist. These UX issues slow users down and cause annoyance despite an otherwise user-friendly layout.
example_quotes: UI is third class compared to all apps... many unnecessary screens... UI must need to improve.
Very user-friendly interface great for beginners

themes.name: Customer Support & Service
themes.description: Complaints of unresponsive or inefficient support recur. Calls and tickets often go unanswered or delayed, leaving users frustrated and undermining trust. Reviewers say they feel 'harassed' by lack of help when problems arise. Poor support for issues like failed trades or refunds is a major concern driving negative sentiment.
example_quotes: Guys your customer service is sooo worst... not even a single call is connected... I'm harassed... no solution.
Support resolved my issue in under 2 hours!
